{{Top|leg}}
The '''Unified Matter/Energy Theory''' was a field of study that attracted many [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuins]]. It was assumed that their interest stemmed from a genetic flaw in the Duinuogwuin's [[Reproduction/Legends|reproductive]] system that meant that the offspring of two Duinuogwuins had a greater than average chance of being born as an unintelligent, mindless beast. The theory's hypothesis on organic cold fusion was believed to hold the key to the Duinuogwuin's problem.
